method: built-in image_gen; five generated source assets, deterministic five-layer card assembly

variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / reusable illustration layer. The reference image is the APPROVED retro casino card-face design; match its exact delicate printed texture, mint, deep evergreen and antique-gold palette, fine irregular engraved rays, speckled ink and graceful 1950s star ornaments. Produce ONE production compositing layer, upright portrait 512:716 aspect ratio (prefer 1024x1432 or equivalent), no perspective. Not a triptych, not three cards, not a mockup sheet. Full canvas represents one card; never crop or fit the ornament bounding box to fill the canvas. Every element must be sharp, elegant and faithfully like the reference rather than simplified geometric approximations. Absolutely NO rank letters, numbers, words, suit symbols, characters, portraits, watermarks, or labels anywhere. No cast shadows or glow. LAYER 1 OF 5: ONLY THE MINT PAPER. Fill the entire rectangular canvas edge to edge with the softly luminous pale mint/ivory paper of the reference. Match its subtle fine mottling, delicate print grain, minute scattered fibers, restrained green flecks, slight warmth and vignette. Center and edges remain pale, clean, and close in value; nothing dark. Uniform material, no frame, border, stars, rays, medallions, card edge or corner roundness. Opaque paper texture only. Do not reproduce any ink art. This layer sits underneath every other component.
